name: capsule
description: Private, temporary and resilient encrypted capsule transport.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @capsule/protocol && npm run build -w @capsule/sdk && npm run build -w @capsule/mixnet && npm run build -w @capsule/lan
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @capsule/relay && npm run build -w @capsule/cli && npm run build -w @capsule/web && npm run build -w @capsule/extension
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -k -n relay,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @capsule/relay" "npm run dev -w @capsule/web"
scripts.dev:relay: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @capsule/relay
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @capsule/web
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @capsule/extension
